''''Colorful Set'''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that hangs on a wall. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|500}} and it can be purchased for {{Price|500}} from [[Pierre]]'s booth at the [[Egg Festival]].

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.
